name: Austin Proper Hotel
positioning: Kelly Wearstler-designed hotel in downtown Austin's Second Street District, steps from Lady Bird Lake, with a 5th-floor saltwater rooftop pool, Verbena Spa and a Recovery Room
best_for: Travelers who want a downtown Austin base steps from Lady Bird Lake
Design lovers drawn to Kelly Wearstler interiors
Guests who want spa and recovery treatments during their stay

facts.text: The hotel is in the Second Street District of downtown Austin, steps from Lady Bird Lake and ACL Live.
The hotel is near 6th Street, the historic Texas State Capitol and the University of Texas campus.
Designer Kelly Wearstler curated the design throughout the hotel.
The rooms use local woods and stones from nearby quarries.
The Proper Penthouse Suite has a 550-square-foot furnished private terrace.
The rooftop pool is a saltwater pool.
The pool deck has three 18-foot-tall cabanas, each designed for up to 8 guests.
The Recovery Room offers cold plunge, dry sauna and red light therapy.
Verbena Spa's aromatherapy collection was made exclusively for the hotel and spa by Rootfoot founder Laura Huth, using local native plants.
The men's and women's locker rooms each have a steam room.
The Peacock, the hotel's flagship restaurant, serves Mediterranean cuisine.
The hotel received a 2026 Forbes Travel Guide Four Star award.

highlights.text: The 5th-floor rooftop pool offers panoramic skyline views.
Kelly Wearstler designed the rooms and suites as modern interpretations of Austin's Craftsman architectural style.
Many rooms and suites offer city views and sunset views.
The spa's Tequila: The Proper Way ritual begins with a sip of Austin's own Lalo Tequila, followed by a guided desert meditation and therapeutic massage.
Guests can book a private hat shaping experience at Maufrais on South Congress Avenue.

considerations.text: Verbena Spa is open to the public as well as hotel guests.
The building is shared with 99 Proper branded residences on floors 12 to 32 above the hotel.
WhataHotel notes the urban setting may involve city noise.
